# Implementation Plan: `006-storytelling-intro`

**Branch**: `006-storytelling-intro` | **Date**: 2026-08-19 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/006-storytelling-intro/spec.md`
**Note**: This plan is the output of the `/sp.plan` command. Tasks are generated by `/sp.tasks`; this file does NOT contain tasks.

---

## Summary

Rewrite `edu-site/docs/intro.md` into a 30-minute, story-driven Introduction that dramatizes the **two extremes** (blind vibe coding; AI resistance) using real, verified stories and quotes, then lands the **Spec-Driven Engineering** bridge as the platform's curriculum thesis. The rewrite carries forward all 24 factual claims from the current page (per the user's mid-spec clarification) and adds new verified facts from the research pool where they strengthen a beat.

The implementation is editorial: three writing passes (draft → fact-check → pacing review), a build pass, and a small reader panel. No new infrastructure, dependencies, components, routes, or design tokens. The plan exercises Constitution III (Co-Authored Text) end to end — the agent drafts, the project owner reviews, the project owner ships.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Markdown (CommonMark + Docusaurus-flavoured extensions). Plain text; no JSX, no TSX, no component imports.
**Primary Dependencies**: Docusaurus 3.7 (existing; reused). The site's `edu-site/scripts/generate-search-index.mjs` (from feature `005-redesign-navbar-hero`) automatically indexes the rewritten prose.
**Storage**: N/A. Static site.
**Testing**: `cd edu-site && npm run build` (must exit 0). `npm run check:frontmatter` runs as part of build and must pass for `intro.md`. No unit tests; the deliverable is prose.
**Target Platform**: Web; desktop ≥ 996 px and mobile < 996 px; both light and dark modes (Docusaurus handles theme tokens; the rewrite does not introduce visual changes).
**Project Type**: Web application (Docusaurus static site) — single content page, no backend change.
**Performance Goals**: Body word count 6,800–7,600 (30-minute read at 230 wpm); `npm run build` ≤ typical Docusaurus build time (no new build steps; same harness as feature `005-redesign-navbar-hero`).
**Constraints**: Per Constitution — Apple-Design Purity (Principle VII) is unaffected (no visual change); Co-Authored Text (Principle III) is the workflow backbone; Free-Tier (Principle I) holds (no new cost surface); Spec-Driven Development (Principle IV) is the lifecycle.
**Scale/Scope**: One page. ~7,200 words of prose. ~14 Story Cards. ~24 mandatory retained facts. ~10 verbatim quotes. ~13 anchor beats. n ≥ 5 reader panel.

## Phase 0 — Research → Complete

Research was performed during `/sp.specify` by three parallel subagents dispatched on 2026-08-19:

- **Subagent 1 — blind vibe coding stories**: 7 verified Story Cards (A1–A7). See `research.md` §A.1.
- **Subagent 2 — AI resistance stories**: 7 verified Story Cards (B1–B7). See `research.md` §A.2.
- **Subagent 3 — adoption stats + expert quotes**: 15 stat cards, 10 verbatim quotes, 13 anchor beats. See `research.md` §A.3, §A.4, §A.5.

A **mid-spec clarification** from the user ("note that when rewriting, the previous facts and figures should also be told in some way") became a first-class constraint: spec FR-007 was strengthened, spec Appendix A.6 was added with 24 mandatory retained facts, and `research.md` §A.6 mirrors it as the canonical mapping. SC-013 / SC-014 enforce it at ship time.

Decisions recorded as **R-001 … R-008** in `research.md`:

| ID | Decision | One-line summary |
|----|----------|------------------|
| R-001 | Source file is `intro.md`, not the sibling landing card | Welcome page stays as a scanable summary |
| R-002 | Two-extreme narrative spine with a documented bridge | Symmetry is the lesson, not a one-pole tract |
| R-003 | Verified real stories are mandatory, not optional | The platform's contract with students |
| R-004 | Three parallel subagents on 2026-08-19 | Methodology with caveats honoured in citations |
| R-005 | The "previous facts" must also be told | FR-007 + A.6 + SC-013/SC-014 |
| R-006 | 30-min read is a word-count band (6,800–7,600), not a feeling | SC-001 |
| R-007 | Pacing discipline requires explicit rules, not vibes | Pacing contract operationalises "dopamine" |
| R-008 | Co-authoring loop with the project owner (Constitution III) | Three passes with explicit exit criteria |

**Output**: `research.md` is complete.

## Phase 1 — Design & Contracts → Complete

- **`data-model.md`** — Editorial entities (Story Card, Fact Claim, Quote, Source, Beat, Per-Fact Mapping Table) with fields, validation rules, and a verification matrix mapping each SC to the entity that anchors it.
- **`contracts/content-contract.md`** — Page identity, six-beat spine, mandatory retained facts (A.6), anchor beats, scanability blocks, reading-time badge, "complete" gate.
- **`contracts/sourcing-contract.md`** — The rule that every claim traces to a source, attribution honesty rules, methodology caveats for SO/JetBrains/Stanford/Octoverse/METR/Veracode/LinkedIn/S&P, source discipline, what the writer must NOT do, the fact-check pass, verifiability-tier rules.
- **`contracts/pacing-contract.md`** — Six-beat section rules (cold-open, extremes, shared-trap, bridge, CTA), paragraph-level rules (no three-stat runs, hook on every opener, closing transfer, sentence rhythm, curiosity gap with payoff), paragraph types (scene / stat / teacher-aside / transition / quote), forbidden and allowed mechanics, the pacing-review pass.
- **`contracts/navigation-contract.md`** — Page route, frontmatter, sidebar order, internal links, outbound links, no images/video, plain Markdown only, build, search index, backward compatibility, "complete" gate.
- **`quickstart.md`** — The 5-pass authoring flow: Pass 0 baseline → Pass 1 draft → Pass 2 fact-check (blocking) → Pass 3 pacing → Pass 4 build → Pass 5 reader panel; Definition of Done.

**Output**: data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md complete.

## Phase 2 — Tasks (deferred to `/sp.tasks`)

This plan does NOT generate tasks; `/sp.tasks` will decompose the work into ordered, dependency-aware tasks that respect the spec's user stories (US1–US4) and the contract gates. The expected task surface:

- **Setup** — baseline inventory of the current `intro.md`; confirm branch; verify prerequisites.
- **Foundational** — Per-Fact Mapping Table scaffold; verification directory created; references prepared.
- **US1 (P1)** — Cold-open + Extreme A + Extreme B + Shared Trap + Bridge + CTA, in beat order, with the per-fact weaving.
- **US2 (P1)** — Fact-check pass: Per-Fact Mapping Table complete; every claim traced; sources section populated.
- **US3 (P2)** — Pacing review: paragraph-by-paragraph classification; no three-stat runs; hooks/transfers verified.
- **US4 (P2)** — Build + reader panel + ship gate.
- **Polish** — PHRs recorded; final commit; PR.
